results.name: ICMP echo baseline
results.intent: Liveness baseline: a well-formed ping must be answered.

results.name: Malformed ARP
results.intent: Bogus hlen/plen and truncated ARP must not corrupt the ARP cache or crash.

results.name: ARP request flood
results.intent: Rapid gratuitous/who-has flood: bounded ARP table, no OOM crash.

results.name: Oversized ICMP echo (fragmented)
results.intent: Multi-fragment ICMP (3KB, 2-3 fragments) must reassemble or drop cleanly without crashing.

results.name: Malformed ICMP
results.intent: Bad ICMP checksum / truncated header must be dropped, not parsed.

results.name: IP bad header checksum
results.intent: Corrupt IPv4 header checksum must cause a silent drop.

results.name: Overlapping IP fragments
results.intent: Teardrop-style overlapping fragments must not mis-reassemble or crash.

results.name: Incomplete fragment bomb
results.intent: Many never-completed fragments must be reaped (bounded reassembly memory).

results.name: UDP recv baseline
results.intent: A well-formed datagram reaches the recv callback and is handled.

results.name: Oversized fragmented UDP
results.intent: Large fragmented UDP payload must not overflow the recv path.

results.name: UDP bad length/checksum
results.intent: UDP length field longer than the packet / bad checksum must be dropped.

results.name: SYN to closed port
results.intent: SYN to an unbound port must elicit a RST, not a hang or crash.

results.name: TCP listen baseline
results.intent: A normal connect + data exchange must be accepted and read.

results.name: Malformed TCP flags
results.intent: NULL / FIN / XMAS / SYN+FIN flag combos must be dropped or RST, not crash.

results.name: Tiny/zero window + overlap
results.intent: Zero-window probes and overlapping segments must not desync or overrun.

results.name: Oversized TCP data burst
results.intent: A data burst far larger than the app recv buffer must be bounded (no overflow).

results.name: TLS clean echo
results.intent: TLS 1.3 baseline: complete handshake, receive encrypted payload, echo it back.

results.name: TLS PSK resume echo
results.intent: Second connection should resume by TLS 1.3 PSK/session ticket, then echo encrypted data.

results.name: TLS missing record
results.intent: Server accepts TCP and drops the handshake before any TLS record; calc must fail closed and stay alive.

results.name: TLS unsupported certverify
results.intent: Server presents an ECDSA TLS 1.3 identity; calc must reject unsupported CertificateVerify behavior and stay alive.
